AbilityDef.label: time alter: double accel
AbilityDef.description: Open the lattice to twice normal rate for 20 seconds - fast enough to cross open ground before a volley lands, or to finish a melee before it starts properly.\n\nThe strain heals off over about three days, so this is the one you can afford to use regularly, but it stacks: twice in an afternoon is not the same as twice in a week.

AbilityDef.label: time alter: square accel
AbilityDef.description: Open the lattice all the way - four times normal rate, for six seconds. Enough to cross a killzone, reach a downed colonist, or end a fight outright.\n\nIt is also very nearly enough to ruin the carrier: one full use takes strain most of the way to critical, where the lattice begins leaving damage that never heals.

AbilityDef.label: time alter: stagnate
AbilityDef.description: Run the lattice backwards - a third of normal rate, for a full minute. The carrier can barely move or act, and in exchange everything happening to them slows by the same factor: blood loss, infection, poison, all of it.\n\nSlowing down is the direction the body tolerates, so it costs no strain at all.
